summary: Iteration 153: Tested AI Candidate Screening Enhancement feature. All 11 backend tests passed (1 skipped). Frontend UI testing confirmed all 3 tabs (Sourced, System Suggestion, Search Bank) working correctly with multi-dimensional score bars, matched/missing skills badges, and full candidate profile expansion.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/suggestions returns AI suggestions with multi-dimensional scores
✅ Response includes: score, skill_match_score, experience_match_score, ctc_fit_score, notice_fit_score, stability_score
✅ Suggestions are sorted by score descending (highest first)
✅ Suggestions exclude candidates already linked to the job
✅ Skill matching uses synonym resolution (ML=Machine Learning, JS=JavaScript etc) - verified in matching_engine.py
✅ CTC fit scoring checks candidate salary vs job budget range - _calc_ctc_fit function
✅ Notice period scoring favors immediate joiners - _calc_notice_fit function
✅ Stability scoring penalizes frequent job hoppers - _calc_stability function
✅ Frontend: Add Candidate dialog has 3 tabs - Sourced, System Suggestion, Search Bank
✅ Frontend: System Suggestion tab shows AI-scored candidates with circular score badges
✅ Frontend: Expanding a candidate shows multi-dimensional score bars (Skills, Exp, CTC Fit, Notice, Stability)
✅ Frontend: Expanding shows matched skills (green badges), contact info, summary, skills list
✅ Frontend: Search Bank tab has search input that queries candidate bank (requires 2+ chars)
✅ Frontend: Add button available to link candidate to job
seed_data_creation: Used existing job 'ME/SME-Channel Sales-Paints-Thoothukudi' (id: a82bd503-a5e0-4c9d-b392-cc383a1a60ff) with 48 pre-generated suggestions
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Candidate Screening Enhancement fully tested. The job suggestions endpoint returns multi-dimensional scores (skill_match_score, experience_match_score, ctc_fit_score, notice_fit_score, stability_score). Frontend AddCandidateToMandateDialog.jsx has 3 tabs with data-testid attributes: tab-sourced, tab-suggestions, tab-search. Expand buttons have data-testid='expand-btn-{candidate_id}'. The matching engine uses synonym resolution for skills and calculates CTC fit, notice period fit, and stability scores.
